description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
d=64: L1 copies query digit; L2 attention mass on matching digits encodes count; MLP tent -|F-theta_d| decodes digit; pos11 forced 0.
d=48 but attention scale still hardcoded for d=64 (bug): under-counts by 1.
d=48, attention scale uses sqrt(d), nonmatch score -12.
M=10: LayerNorm scale varies too much between positions.
d=37: position one-hot replaced by is-pos-10 / is-pos-11 flags.
MLP removed; head logits are lines tangent to a parabola in F (argmax = nearest theta_d).
Q=5: nonmatching digits leak too much attention mass.
'=' token embedding carries the pos-11 flag instead of the position embedding.
layer-1 attention score 6: copy of query digit is blurred.

d=27, 2 layers, 1 head, no MLP: L1 copies query digit (pos 10); L2 attention softmax mass F on matching digits (vs 2 sink positions) encodes count; head logits are parabola-tangent lines of F; '=' token forces first digit 0.
